decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed use of Units 10+11 Syon Gateway for the display, sale and repair of motor vehicles together with its refurbishment, is considered to be an acceptable employment generating use of the premises, which will promote and enhance the Great West Road and the setting of listed building. This is accordance with policies IMP.4.2 (The Great West Road), IMP.5.1 (High Quality Buildings and Urban Design), ENV.B.1.1 (New Development), ENV.B.2.5 (Development Affecting the Setting of a Listed Building), E.1.5 (Development Involving Loss of/ Changes in Employment Uses) of the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan. Where the development is not in accordance with UDP there are considered to be no adverse affects resulting from this.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 4 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details
Condition : 5 - No additional floorspace shall be formed within the buildings hereby permitted by means of internal horizontal division without prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - No development shall take place until full details of both hard and soft landscape works have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and these works shall be carried out as approved.   Soft landscape works shall include planting plans; written specifications (including cultivation and other operations associated with plant and grass establishment); schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes and proposed numbers/densities where appropriate; implementation programme

Condition : 7 - Before first occupation of the buildings the loading, unloading and turning space, and parking spaces (including spaces for people with disabilities) shall be provided within the curtilage of the site in accordance with the scheme shown on drawing No. R11871 101 Rev A  and such spaces shall be permanently available and not be used for any other purpose.

Condition : 8 - 
7) The 24 internal and external designated car parking bays shown on drawing No, R11871 101 Rev A shall not be used for purposes of the display or sale of vehicles and shall be permanently marked out and retained.

Condition : 9 - The measures identified in the document entitled s Employee Travel Plan Final Draft (mjr/2005-012) submitted to and approved by the Council shall all be introduced and put into effect upon commencement of the use hereby permitted and shall thereafter be maintained in place at all times while the car showroom remains in operation.  The operator of the showroom from time to time shall provide the Council with a monitoring report at yearly intervals for five years from the date on which the use commenced, which report shall contain review of the strategies imposed, the targets identified and the new targets to be achieved.

Reason: To encourage means of transport other than the private car and to reduce on street parking which would be detrimental to highway safety.
There shall be no delivery to the site from articulated lorries

Condition : 10 - 9) No deliveries shall be made to the site by car transporters, and at no time shall car-transporters unload on Syon Gate Way.

Reason: To avoid danger and inconvenience to Highway Use

Condition : 11 - 10) Prior to the commencement of the development hereby permitted, a management plan shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority containing a set of measures to ensure that no parking of car transporters or other parking associated with the use of the site shall take place in Syon Gate Way.  The approved scheme shall be implemented in full within one month following the substantial completion of the development and thereafter permanently retained.
description: Change of use from warehouse units to a building for the sale and display of motor vehicles, vehicle repairs and servicing, ancillary offices, external alterations, vehicle parking and landscaping.
